g.title: HR_SALARYREVIEWGUIDELINE
g.text: Salary Review Guideline - This is a decision support tool for people in charge of a salary review. Represents a matrix with two dimensions on X and Y axis, representing an attribute of an employee. The cell is a min/max salary increase for each couple of attribute values.
In the matrix, it is the entity dimension used for the X axis.
In the matrix, it is the entity dimension used for the Y axis.
In this field you might reference the entity where X attribute is assigned (historically or not) to a given person/worker.
It’s the reference to the field which includes the individual X attribute.
In this field you might reference the entity where Y attribute is assigned (historically or not) to a given person/worker.
It’s the reference to the field which includes the individual Y attribute.
Is a custom salary review guideline
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_SALREVGUIDELINERANGES
g.text: Salary Review Guideline Ranges - It’s the suggested salary increase range, from min to max.
It’s the suggestion matrix that can be used to propose to the reviewer a range of increases for a participant based on two attributes (example his/her performance and his/her grade).
The minimum suggested percentage of increase.
The maximum suggested percentage of increase.
